graph.description: How devices connect to the CVEs to look at first. Click a device or a CVE to follow its links, then open its details from the bar under the graph.
graph.priorityHint: Ordered by facts we hold, not by a guess.
graph.noPriority: There are no CVEs in this graph.
graph.whyIntro: Each CVE gets a score that adds up facts we hold. The highest score comes first.
graph.whyKev: CISA KEV: the public list of vulnerabilities exploited in real attacks (largest weight).
graph.whyExploit: Falcon exploit status: actively used, easily accessible or exploit available.
graph.whyExprt: CrowdStrike ExPRT: CrowdStrike's model of how likely a vulnerability is to be exploited.
graph.whyInternet: Internet exposure: found on a device that can be reached from the internet (Falcon).
graph.whySeverity: Falcon severity (Critical, High, Medium) and the CVSS score.
graph.whyDevices: Number of devices affected (more devices, more urgent).
graph.pickHint: Click a device or a CVE in the graph to see what it is linked to.
